short_description:
The GTA 6 Silent Hill easter egg: the abandoned Marbelle Hotel in southern Crosstown, on NW 8th Street near the Nine1Nine club (boarded-up windows, a For Sale sign). Go in through the unlocked back door and head upstairs: the lights go out and fog covers the city. The ground-floor safe code is 955214 (cash and a Crowex watch inside); opening it is the surest way to clear the fog. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #9 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: VGC, Dexerto, Hold to Reset, TheClick, Playnews, gta6.house.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).

short_es.description:
El easter egg de Silent Hill en GTA 6: el Marbelle Hotel abandonado, en el sur de Crosstown (NW 8th Street, cerca del club Nine1Nine). Entra por la puerta de atrás y sube: se apagan las luces y la niebla cubre la ciudad. La clave de la caja fuerte de la planta baja es 955214 (dinero y un reloj Crowex). Fuentes: VGC, Dexerto, Hold to Reset, TheClick, Playnews.
